relationships.subject: Nav1.6
relationships.evidence_quote: Amongst these subunits, Nav1.6 seems to be responsible for a major portion of INaP in the central nervous system (CNS) [186].

relationships.subject: Nav1.8
relationships.evidence_quote: In dorsal root ganglion (DRG) neurons, Nav1.8 and Nav1.9 have been suggested to be responsible for INaP [119].

relationships.subject: riluzole
relationships.evidence_quote: At present, GS967 and riluzole can be regarded bona fide I<sub>NaP</sub> blockers

key_findings: Review: GS967 and riluzole are the best in vitro persistent sodium current blockers for CNS neurons; no blocker spares transient current.
Nav1.6 contributes a major part of CNS INaP, while Nav1.8 and Nav1.9 are suggested to underlie INaP in DRG neurons.
